problem: Finding cards only showed an evidence count and forced users to locate the matching evidence entry in the page-wide evidence section.
root_cause: Finding rendering had no stable relationship to the existing evidence-reference inspector.

change.behavior: A finding with a matching evidence_reference now exposes a keyboard-accessible anchor with aria-controls; activating it opens the existing bounded evidence disclosure and auto-inspects the exact evidence identity.

assertions: finding link targets the stable exact evidence element
aria-controls matches the evidence element id
existing interpretation evidence endpoint is called with the exact interpretation id
evidence inspector resolves the exact historical version
no scientific execution path is introduced

notes: The repository has no configured non-interactive ESLint config; npm run lint enters Next's setup prompt and is not suitable as a focused gate.
new_findings: CO-029 remains the highest-priority open authorization campaign.
